description_preview:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
About the role
The Software Engineer on the Content Ingestion team will design, build, and maintain ingestion pipelines that process millions of assets from linear feeds and multimedia files, powering real-time content matching, recommendations, and advertising insights for Roku's ACR (Automatic Content Recognition) platform. This role focuses on full-stack operations across cloud and on-premises environments, including creating APIs, batch jobs, and infrastructure using AWS and GCP. The engineer will serve as a key liaison between US-based content partners and the engineering team in Seoul, South Korea, ensuring smooth data flow and partner communication. Day-to-day work includes setting up instances, managing deployments, implementing monitoring and observability, and participating in on-call rotations for critical production services. The ideal candidate brings 1–3 years of hands-on engineering experience with a strong foundation in cloud operations, DevOps, and scripting. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer to make a meaningful impact on a globally distributed platform reaching millions of households.
How will I use AI at Roku?
At Roku, we don't just use AI; we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
At Roku, we're embracing AI as a powerful tool to amplify human creativity, accelerate innovation, and deliver better results for our customers. Across teams, we're exploring how AI can enhance our work—and we're looking for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to grow alongside these technologies.
What You'll be doing
Design, implement, and maintain APIs and batch jobs for asset ingestion, processing, and distribution
Create and manage infrastructure for both on-premise and cloud (AWS/GCP) deployments using Terraform and Ansible
Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager
Participate in on-call rotations for critical production services
Optimize system performance, reduce costs, and manage technical debt
Communicate with US-based content partners to gather requirements and coordinate data ingestion
Collaborate with international engineering teams in Utah and Seoul, South Korea, including attending cross-timezone standups
Drive AI methodologies and agentic AI workflows within active code repositories
Conduct knowledge-sharing demos and perform code reviews
Manage containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes
Work with CI/CD pipelines and version control via Git
We're Excited if you have
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
1–3 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or cloud operations
Proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, Bash, C++, or Go
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP (Compute, Storage, Networking, Managed Services)
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and Ansible
Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes
Strong understanding of Linux distributions and command-line tools
Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB)
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Understanding of message queues, caching strategies, and horizontal/vertical scaling
Fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain, including coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for cross-timezone and cross-cultural collaboration
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and flexibility to occasionally collaborate across international time zones
What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. Description
Digital Finance Transformation - Data Scientist: Associate – Private Equity Performance Improvement
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice works with private equity held portfolio companies and provides our clients with solutions to preserve and generate value for their businesses. Our goal is to improve transparency to key drivers and business performance, to support increasing cash and EBITDA, and to provide benefits through hands-on involvement in our clients’ operations. Our job is to support PE firms to ensure their portfolio companies have credible plans and the ability to execute and deliver financial outcomes.
Our PEPI CFO Services practice includes the following pillar of services:
Strategic Finance and Liquidity Management
Accounting Advisory and Financial Reporting Solutions
Working Capital Optimization
Digital Finance Transformation
Interim Management
How You Will Contribute
We are seeking an Associate or Senior Associate to join our Digital Finance Transformation team within PEPI. This role focuses on helping private equity portfolio companies accelerate digital enablement within the finance function—modernizing data environments, automating processes, and building analytics-driven tools that create measurable business impact.
The ideal candidate blends strong technical expertise in Python, SQL, and modern data platforms with a solid understanding of finance and accounting operations. You will work directly with CFOs, Controllers, and FP&A leaders to design, implement, and operationalize digital solutions that improve performance, transparency, and scalability.

3-6 plus years of professional experience; consulting or professional services experience preferred.
Advanced Python programming experience, including familiarity with machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).

Experience with ETL/orchestration tools (Dagster, Temporal, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Fivetran, Matillion).
Demonstrated ability to develop lightweight finance applications using Streamlit or Retool.
Solid understanding of finance and accounting concepts, including forecasting, working capital management, and three-statement modeling.
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills; proven ability to translate between finance and technology teams.
Ability to travel as required

The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
The salary range is $90,000--$130,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

reason: Stack +9; Title fit +6; Entry +15; Exp fit +6; US +10
description_preview:
Role: Jr. Controls Engineer
Location:
Fairport, NY
This is an outstanding place to work!
It all starts with the people. You will love working with colleagues who have a genuine desire to innovate and solve complex problems. We come to work every day striving to make the organization better than it was the day before—asking tough questions, pushing boundaries, and supporting each other in an environment that values authenticity, clarity, inclusion, and diversity. Qualitrol associates enjoy the autonomy, breadth of responsibility, and creativity typical of a medium-sized company, while benefiting from the resources, standard methodologies, and career opportunities of a Fortune 500 organization like Ralliant.
Your Impact
As a Junior Controls Engineer, you will support the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing automation and control systems. Working closely with experienced engineers, manufacturing teams, and the Smart Factory Data Engineer, you will help connect production equipment to Qualitrol's digital manufacturing ecosystem. This role plays a key part in enabling reliable machine connectivity, data acquisition, and operational improvements that support our Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives.
Here’s Where You’ll Demonstrate Your Proficiency
Configure PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, sensors, and industrial devices to provide reliable operational data to manufacturing information systems.

Torc is hiring an Autonomy Data Engineer Level 2 to help design, build and operate the data infrastructure that powers our autonomy program.
